name: Soga Azusa
source:
Former boss of the protagonist. An ambitious career woman with a strong desire to advance.

She takes a very strict attitude toward incompetent subordinates and is very careful about compliance while not engaging in overtly power-harassing behavior.

Devoted solely to work, she feels guilty for not being able to pay enough attention to her only son, Tasuku, who she inevitably shows her softer side to.

[From [url=https://syuntada.com/boss/soga.html]official site[/url]]
